mapper.select:
SELECT TOP (200) MSG_KEY AS msgid, CASE WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'ALT' THEN 'AT' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'ALI' THEN 'AI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'FRT' THEN 'FT' WHEN MSG_TYPE IN ('FRI','FRW') THEN 'FI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'BRI' THEN 'BM' WHEN MSG_TYPE IN ('SMS','LMS','MMS') THEN 'PH' ELSE MSG_TYPE END AS messagetype, MESSAGE AS msg, MESSAGE AS msgsms, 'P' AS pcom, SUBJECT AS smslmstit, CALL_TO AS phn, CALL_FROM AS smssender, FORMAT(RES_DATE, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') AS reservedt, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS regdt, SENDER_KEY AS profile, TEMPLATE_CODE AS tmplid, BUTTON AS button, FILE_NAME1 AS filepath1, FILE_NAME2 AS filepath2, FILE_NAME3 AS filepath3 FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MSG_STATE = '1' AND ( RES_DATE IS NULL OR RES_DATE <= GETDATE() )
AND MSG_TYPE IN ('ALT', 'ALI')
AND MSG_TYPE IN ('FRT', 'FRI', 'FRW')
AND MSG_TYPE = 'SMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'LMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'MMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'BRI'
ORDER BY MSG_KEY ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} ( MSG_KEY, MSG_STATE, INPUT_DATE, RES_DATE, SENT_DATE, RSLT_DATE, REPORT_DATE, RSLT_CODE, RSLT_NET, RSLT_TYPE, PRE_RSLT_CODE, PRE_RSLT_NET, PRE_RSLT_TYPE, CALL_TO, CALL_FROM, MSG_TYPE, SUBJECT, MESSAGE, BUTTON, FILE_NAME1, FILE_NAME2, FILE_NAME3, SENDER_KEY, TEMPLATE_CODE, ADV, FALLBACK_YN, FALLBACK_TYPE, FALLBACK_MSG, CLIENT_SEQ, ETC_CHAR1, ETC_CHAR2, ETC_CHAR3, ETC_CHAR4, TRANS_RESULT ) SELECT MSG_KEY, MSG_STATE, INPUT_DATE, RES_DATE, SENT_DATE, RSLT_DATE, REPORT_DATE, RSLT_CODE, RSLT_NET, RSLT_TYPE, PRE_RSLT_CODE, PRE_RSLT_NET, PRE_RSLT_TYPE, CALL_TO, CALL_FROM, MSG_TYPE, SUBJECT, MESSAGE, BUTTON, FILE_NAME1, FILE_NAME2, FILE_NAME3, SENDER_KEY, TEMPLATE_CODE, ADV, FALLBACK_YN, FALLBACK_TYPE, FALLBACK_MSG, CLIENT_SEQ, ETC_CHAR1, ETC_CHAR2, ETC_CHAR3, ETC_CHAR4, TRANS_RESULT FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MSG_KEY = #{msgid}
